Hello! I can help you. 

Look at the bottom numbers. 
We have 3 and 6. 
How do we get from 3 to 6? 
What number do we multiply by?
is it 4/6 because you multiply the bottom by 2 so you have to do the same to the top Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

Great job on that one! 

Now let us look at adding. 
We have 2 over 9 plus 4 over 9. 
The bottom numbers are the same. 
They are both 9. 
So the bottom of our answer stays 9. 

Can you add the top numbers for me? What is 2 plus 4?
is it 6/9 because the bottom stays the same and you just add 2 and 4 Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes! 6 over 9 is right. 

Now we have 1 over 4 plus 1 over 8. 
Look at the bottom numbers. 
They are 4 and 8. 
They are not the same! 
Can you change 1 over 4 so the bottom is 8? 
What do you multiply 4 by to get 8?
